constructions.v1: sha256hex(utf8(agent_id) || utf8(action_type) || utf8(scope) || int64_be(timestamp_ms))  — argentum-core action-ref-v1, raw concatenation, tuple-ambiguous; FROZEN as pinned in interop-freeze-2026-10-01
constructions.v2: sha256hex(JCS({agent_id, action_type, scope, timestamp_ms}))  — RFC 8785, timestamp_ms as JSON integer; framed, injective over the tuple

description: Probity (astrogilda) finding on aeoess/agent-governance-vocabulary#177: moving one byte across the action_type/scope boundary leaves the v1 preimage identical. v1 collides; v2 does not.

expected.verdict: a verifier treating action_ref_v1 as an exact authorization binding would accept tuple b as tuple a; action_ref_v2 distinguishes them
